# Math Time Lab – Interactive 3D/2D Mathematics Simulators
> Official Visual Math Simulation Division of itsmathtime.co.in by Alka Ma'am
> Curriculum: CBSE / NCERT Mathematics (Classes 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12)
> Root URL: https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/
> Parent Platform: https://itsmathtime.co.in/
> Author: Alka Sharma (Alka Ma'am), M.Sc. Mathematics, B.Ed., CTET Certified
> Full Mathematical Proofs & Board Solutions: https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/llms-full.txt

## Overview
Math Time Lab provides 50 free, touch-responsive 2D/3D visual mathematics simulators designed to eliminate math anxiety, demonstrate proofs geometrically, and clarify CBSE board exam concepts through interactive experimentation (Predict-Observe-Explain pedagogy).

## Grade-Level Curriculum Hubs
- [Class 8 Visual Mathematics](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/classes/class-8-math-simulators): Linear Equations, Algebraic Tiles, Compound Interest, Pythagorean Triplets, Euler Polyhedra.
- [Class 9 Visual Mathematics](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/classes/class-9-math-simulators): Distance Formula, Heron's Triangles, Polynomial Factorizer, Lines & Angles, Circle Theorems.
- [Class 10 Visual Mathematics](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/classes/class-10-math-simulators): Quadratic Roots, Heights & Distances, Circle Tangents, Coordinate Section Formula, Similar Triangles.
- [Class 11 Visual Mathematics](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/classes/class-11-math-simulators): 3D Conics Slicer, Unit Circle & Waves, Limits & Tangents, Linear Inequalities, Permutations.
- [Class 12 Visual Mathematics](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/classes/class-12-math-simulators): Calculus Sandbox, 3D Vector Flight Lab, Argand Plane Complex Numbers, FTC Integrals, Bayes Theorem.


## Simulator Directory & Direct Deep-Links

### Class 8 Simulators
- [Linear Equations: Two-Pan Balance Scale Lab](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/balance-scale-equations): Solve linear equations physically! A real-time two-pan brass scale holds variable mystery x-boxes and brass gram weights. Eliminate equal weights and x-boxes from both pans to isolate x without memorizing confusing transposition signs. [NCERT Ch 2: Linear Equations in One Variable - Ex 2.1 – 2.3 (Solving Equations)] (Category: Algebra)
- [Algebraic Identities: Visual Area Tile Lab](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/algebraic-identities-tiles): Never drop 2ab again! Build squares and rectangles with geometric algebra tiles to visually prove (a+b)², (a-b)², and a²-b². Watch the large square decompose into a², b², and two ab rectangles. [NCERT Ch 9: Algebraic Expressions & Identities - Ex 9.5 (Standard Identities)] (Category: Algebra)
- [Comparing Quantities: Compound Interest Vault](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/compound-interest-engine): Understand the power of exponential growth! Compare linear Simple Interest with geometric Compound Interest. Adjust compounding frequency (yearly, half-yearly, quarterly) and watch interest earn interest in real time. [NCERT Ch 8: Comparing Quantities - Ex 8.3 (Compound Interest Formula)] (Category: Algebra)
- [Understanding Quadrilaterals: The Morphing Lab](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/quadrilateral-morpher): Master quadrilateral taxonomy through tactile morphing! Drag 4 vertices freely, or snap to standard constraints (Parallelogram, Rhombus, Rectangle, Square, Kite, Trapezium). Live probes measure diagonal bisections, perpendicularity, and angle sums. [NCERT Ch 3: Understanding Quadrilaterals - Ex 3.3 & 3.4 (Parallelogram & Special Quads)] (Category: Geometry)
- [Visualising Solid Shapes: Euler's 3D Polyhedra Workshop](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/euler-polyhedra-3d): Orbit real 3D solid shapes and unfold them into flat 2D nets! Dynamically count Faces (F), Vertices (V), and Edges (E) to verify Euler’s Formula F + V - E = 2 for cubes, prisms, pyramids, and octahedrons. [NCERT Ch 10: Visualising Solid Shapes - Ex 10.3 (Euler’s Formula)] (Category: Geometry)
- [Direct vs. Inverse Proportions Machine](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/direct-inverse-proportions): Stop guessing which way cross-multiplication works! In Direct Proportion, ratio y/x = k stays constant (double speed = double distance). In Inverse Proportion, product x·y = k stays constant (double workers = half the days). [NCERT Ch 13: Direct and Inverse Proportions - Ex 13.1 & 13.2 (Proportionality Constants)] (Category: Algebra)
- [Data Handling: Dynamic Pie Chart & Central Angle Cutter](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/dynamic-pie-chart): Slice circles with protractor precision! Input survey data, adjust category values, and watch how each slice automatically calculates its central angle θ = (value / total) × 360°. See percentages, frequencies, and degree arcs update synchronously. [NCERT Ch 5: Data Handling - Ex 5.2 (Constructing Pie Charts)] (Category: Probability)
- [Squares & Square Roots: Triplet Forge Lab](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/square-roots-triplets): Pack unit squares into perfect solid squares! Discover why 25 forms a neat 5×5 grid while 27 leaves 2 leftover remainder tiles. Forge Pythagorean Triplets (2m, m²-1, m²+1) by sliding integer m, and watch right triangles snap to integer side lengths. [NCERT Ch 6: Squares and Square Roots - Ex 6.2 (Pythagorean Triplets)] (Category: Algebra)
- [Exponents & Powers: Laws of Indices & Cosmic Scales](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/exponents-powers-lab): Master the fundamental laws of indices through visual factor expansion. Demystify why negative exponents flip to the denominator and explore scientific notation on a cosmic scale. [NCERT Ch 12: Exponents and Powers - Ex 12.1 (Negative Exponents & Laws)] (Category: Algebra)
- [Rational Numbers: Number Line & Infinite Density](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/rational-numbers-density): Zoom microscopically into the continuous number line between any two fractions. Discover why there are infinitely many rational numbers between any two distinct points. [NCERT Ch 1: Rational Numbers - Ex 1.2 (Numbers between Two Rationals)] (Category: Algebra)

### Class 9 Simulators
- [The Drone Navigator: Coordinate Geometry & Distance](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/drone-navigator): Pilot a delivery drone on a Cartesian grid. Drag coordinates, bypass circular No-Fly Zones, and watch how the distance formula is derived from the Pythagorean theorem in real time. [NCERT Ch 3: Coordinate Geometry - Ex 3.2 & 3.3 (Cartesian Coordinates)] (Category: Coordinate Geometry)
- [The Tangent Guardian: Circle Theorems & Tangent Properties](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/circle-theorems): Drag an external point P and observe tangents PA and PB auto-lock onto a circle. Verify why tangent lengths are always equal (PA = PB), observe radius-tangent perpendicularity (90°), and prove that central angles double inscribed angles. [NCERT Ch 10: Circles - Ex 10.4 & 10.5 (Inscribed Angle Theorems)] (Category: Geometry)
- [The Heron Surveyor: Triangle Area & Heron's Formula](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/heron-triangles): Survey any triangle on a 2D coordinate grid. Drag vertices A, B, and C to watch side lengths a, b, c update dynamically and see how Heron’s formula calculates area without needing an altitude line. [NCERT Ch 12: Heron's Formula - Ex 12.1 (Triangle Area via Semi-perimeter)] (Category: Geometry)
- [The Geometric Factorizer: Polynomials & Middle-Term Splitting](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/polynomial-factorizer): Transform abstract algebra into physical geometry! Use colorful 2D algebra tiles (x², x, and 1) to build rectangles and visualize why splitting the middle term works: area = (x + p)(x + q). [NCERT Ch 2: Polynomials - Ex 2.4 & 2.5 (Splitting Middle Term)] (Category: Algebra)
- [The Angle Detective: Parallel Lines & Transversals](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/lines-angles): Rotate parallel lines and adjust the transversal angle. Color-code matching alternate interior (Z-angles), corresponding (F-angles), and consecutive interior (C-angles), and solve the famous board exam Zigzag bend! [NCERT Ch 6: Lines and Angles - Ex 6.2 (Parallel Lines & Transversal)] (Category: Geometry)
- [The 3D Solid Unfolder: Surface Area, Volumes & Net Geometry](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/surface-area-volumes): Unfold 3D cylinders, cones, and cuboids into flat 2D cardboard nets in real time! Pour liquid from a cone into a cylinder of equal height and radius to physically prove that a cone holds exactly 1/3 the volume. [NCERT Ch 13: Surface Areas and Volumes - Ex 13.1 – 13.4 (Cylinder & Cone 2D Nets)] (Category: Geometry)
- [The Circle Chord & Cyclic Quad Lab: Theorems & Supplementary Angles](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/circle-chords-cyclic): Drag chords and cyclic quadrilaterals across a dynamic circle! Watch the perpendicular line dropped from the center bisect any chord (AM = MB), and observe opposite quadrilateral angles sum to exactly 180°. [NCERT Ch 10: Circles - Ex 10.3 & 10.5 (Chords & Cyclic Quads)] (Category: Geometry)
- [The Data Fulcrum: Mean, Median, Mode & Outlier Tug-of-War](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/statistics-visualizer): Transform tedious statistics tables into a physical balancing seesaw! Balance data points on a fulcrum to feel how the Mean acts as the center of mass, pull an extreme outlier to watch the Mean get yanked while the Median stays rock-solid, and construct frequency histograms. [NCERT Ch 14: Statistics - Ex 14.1 & 14.2 (Mean, Median, Mode)] (Category: Probability)
- [Euclid's Axioms & Non-Euclidean Geometry Sandbox](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/euclidean-geometry-sandbox): Explore Euclid's 5th Postulate (Parallel Postulate) and travel beyond flat space! Discover why interior angles on a transversal sum to < 180° when lines intersect, and wrap triangles around an interactive 3D Earth globe where interior angles sum to 270° with 3 right angles. [NCERT Ch 5: Introduction to Euclid's Geometry - Ex 5.1 & 5.2 (Postulates & Axioms)] (Category: Geometry)
- [Triangle Congruence Forge: SAS, SSS, ASA & Traps](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/triangle-congruence-forge): Forge and superimpose geometric triangles on an interactive drafting table. Master the 5 rigid congruence criteria (SAS, SSS, ASA, AAS, RHS) and bust the infamous SSA ambiguous trap. [NCERT Ch 7: Triangles - Ex 7.1 – 7.3 (Congruence Criteria)] (Category: Geometry)

### Class 10 Simulators
- [The Catapult Siege: Trigonometry, Heights & Elevation](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/catapult-siege): Launch projectiles over towering castle walls. Dial the angle of elevation θ and tension velocity to decompose motion into horizontal (cos θ) and vertical (sin θ) components. [NCERT Ch 4: Quadratic Equations - Ex 4.3 (Parabolic Trajectories & Heights)] (Category: Trigonometry)
- [Trigonometric Unit Circle & Wave Synthesizer](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/unit-circle): Touch and rotate any angle on the unit circle. Watch sin(θ), cos(θ), and tan(θ) unfold into continuous harmonic waves with amplitude and frequency modulators. [NCERT Ch 8: Introduction to Trigonometry - Ex 8.1 & 8.2 (Trigonometric Ratios & Angles)] (Category: Trigonometry)
- [The Monty Hall Probability Casino: Bayes & Conditional Odds](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/monty-hall): Experience the world's most famous probability paradox with 3 mystery doors. Choose to Stay or Switch after Monty reveals a goat, then run the 1,000-round Monte Carlo engine to prove Bayes' Theorem. [NCERT Ch 13: Probability - Ex 13.1 (Conditional Probability & Sample Space)] (Category: Trigonometry)
- [The Parabola Root Hunter: Quadratic Equations & Zeroes](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/quadratic-roots): Hunt quadratic roots by scrubbing coefficients a, b, and c. Watch the parabola shift across the Cartesian plane, track the axis of symmetry x = -b/(2a), and observe how discriminant D = b² - 4ac determines whether roots are real or complex. [NCERT Ch 4: Quadratic Equations - Ex 4.4 (Nature of Roots & Discriminant)] (Category: Algebra)
- [The Linear Crossroads: Systems of Two-Variable Equations](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/linear-systems): Navigate two intersecting highway lines on a 2D Cartesian grid. Adjust slopes and intercepts to visualize consistent unique solutions, parallel non-intersecting tracks (no solution), and coincident overlapping lines (infinite solutions). [NCERT Ch 3: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables - Ex 3.1 & 3.2 (Graphical Intersections)] (Category: Algebra)
- [The Lighthouse Clinometer: Heights & Distances](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/trig-heights): Use a surveyor clinometer to measure tower heights and ship distances. Drag the observer along the ground or ocean, switch between angle of elevation and depression, and solve the classic dual-angle board exam problem in real time. [NCERT Ch 9: Some Applications of Trigonometry - Ex 9.1 (Heights & Distances)] (Category: Trigonometry)
- [Similar Triangles & Thales Theorem: Basic Proportionality Lab](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/similar-triangles): Slide parallel transversal line DE across triangle ABC. Prove the Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT / Thales: AD/DB = AE/EC) using real-time area ratios, explore the Converse of BPT, and scale real-world sun shadows to calculate heights of ancient pyramids. [NCERT Ch 6: Triangles - Ex 6.2 (Basic Proportionality Theorem / BPT)] (Category: Geometry)
- [Arithmetic Progression (AP): nth Term & Gauss Ladder](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/arithmetic-progression-lab): Step up the visual bar ladder of arithmetic sequences. Discover young Carl Friedrich Gauss’s interlocking staircase proof for the sum of n terms. [NCERT Ch 5: Arithmetic Progressions - Ex 5.2 & 5.3 (n-th Term & Sum of AP)] (Category: Algebra)
- [Coordinate Geometry: Section Formula & Centroid](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/coordinate-section-formula): Divide line segments in internal and external ratios m₁ : m₂. Master cross-multiplication pairing and observe triangle medians intersecting at the centroid in a 2:1 ratio. [NCERT Ch 7: Coordinate Geometry - Ex 7.2 (Section Formula & Midpoints)] (Category: Coordinate Geometry)
- [Circle Tangents: Equal Lengths & Perpendicular Radii](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/circle-tangents-lab): Interact with tangents drawn from an external point to a circle. Verify Theorem 10.1 (Radius ⊥ Tangent) and Theorem 10.2 (Lengths PA = PB) with RHS congruence. [NCERT Ch 10: Circles - Ex 10.2 (Lengths of Tangents from External Point)] (Category: Geometry)

### Class 11 Simulators
- [The Flashlight & Cone Slicer: 3D Conic Sections](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/conic-sections): Explore a 3D double cone intersected by an adjustable laser cutting plane. Tilt the cutting plane angle θ against cone aperture α to generate circles, ellipses, parabolas, and hyperbolas. [NCERT Ch 11: Conic Sections - Ex 11.1 – 11.4 (Double-Cone Cutting Plane)] (Category: Conics & 3D)
- [The Argand Plane Playground: Complex Numbers & Phase Rotations](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/argand-plane): Explore complex numbers z = a + bi in the 2D complex plane. Drag points with interactive physics, add complex vectors tip-to-tail, and trigger 90° counter-clockwise rotations by multiplying with imaginary unit i. [NCERT Ch 5: Complex Numbers & Quadratic Equations - Ex 5.2 (Argand Plane & Polar Form)] (Category: Linear Algebra)
- [The Binomial Galton Board: Pascal's Triangle & Combinations](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/binomial-galton): Drop thousands of physics balls down a triangular pegboard! Watch how each left/right peg bounce generates Pascal’s triangle numbers ⁿCᵣ, expands (x+y)ⁿ, and organically builds the Gaussian bell curve. [NCERT Ch 8: Binomial Theorem - Ex 8.1 & 8.2 (Pascal Triangle & Coefficients)] (Category: Algebra)
- [The Sequence Explorer: Arithmetic & Geometric Progressions](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/arithmetic-geometric-explorer): Explore arithmetic staircases and geometric spirals! Discover Gauss’s trick for summing APs, watch infinite geometric terms 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + ... converge to a finite area of 1, and test divergence when |r| ≥ 1. [NCERT Ch 9: Sequences and Series - Ex 9.3 (Geometric Progression & Infinite Sum)] (Category: Algebra)
- [The Focal Orbit Lab: Kepler's Laws & Conic String Properties](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/hyperbola-ellipse-orbits): Explore the physical gardener’s string property of conics! Move point P around two foci to verify d₁ + d₂ = 2a (ellipse) and |d₁ - d₂| = 2a (hyperbola), and watch a planet orbit a gravitational focal star via Kepler’s 1st Law. [NCERT Ch 11: Conic Sections - Ex 11.1 & 11.4 (Focal Distances & Orbits)] (Category: Conics & 3D)
- [The Tangent Secant Zoom Lab: Limits & First Principles](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/limits-derivatives-lab): Watch secant lines smoothly snap into the instantaneous tangent line as step size h approaches 0! Zoom in 100x through a local linearity microscope to see that every smooth curve becomes a straight line, and visually verify lim (sin x)/x = 1 via the squeeze theorem. [NCERT Ch 13: Limits and Derivatives - Ex 13.1 & 13.2 (First Principles & Tangents)] (Category: Calculus)
- [The Feasible Region: Linear Inequalities & Half-Plane Optimizer](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/linear-inequalities): Slice the 2D Cartesian plane into shaded half-planes! Drag a test point (x, y) to check constraint satisfaction with real-time green/red feedback, find bounded convex polygon feasible regions, and sweep an objective line Z = px + qy to find optimal corner points. [NCERT Ch 6: Linear Inequalities - Ex 6.2 & 6.3 (Graphical Solution in Two Variables)] (Category: Algebra)
- [The Arrangement Matrix: Permutations vs Combinations Lock](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/permutations-combinations): Crack a mechanical combination lock! Choose n items and pick r of them to directly experience why Permutations (order matters, nPr) produce huge numbers, while Combinations (order does not matter, nCr) collapse redundant rearrangements by dividing by r!, and spin circular seating tables to discover (n-1)!. [NCERT Ch 7: Permutations and Combinations - Ex 7.2 – 7.4 (Arrangements vs Selections)] (Category: Algebra)
- [Principle of Mathematical Induction: Domino Chain](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/mathematical-induction-dominos): Experience the physics domino cascade of Mathematical Induction. Understand why Base Case P(1) and the Inductive Step P(k) ⟹ P(k+1) guarantee truth across all natural numbers. [NCERT Ch 4: Principle of Mathematical Induction - Ex 4.1 (Inductive Step P(k) ⇒ P(k+1))] (Category: Algebra)
- [Trigonometric Equations: General Solutions & Radial Radar](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/trig-equations-radial): Radar sweep across all quadrants of the unit circle to visualize principal values and the infinite families of general solutions for sin, cos, and tan equations. [NCERT Ch 3: Trigonometric Functions - Ex 3.4 (General Solutions of Trig Equations)] (Category: Trigonometry)

### Class 12 Simulators
- [The Matrix Meme Machine: 2D Transformations & Singularities](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/matrix-meme): Transform graphics and coordinate grids using a 2x2 matrix [a, b; c, d]. Drag sliders to shear, rotate, and scale. Watch 2D space physically collapse into a 1D line when the determinant det(A) = ad - bc drops to 0. [NCERT Ch 4: Determinants - Ex 4.3 (Area of Triangle via Determinants)] (Category: Linear Algebra)
- [Derivative Tangent & Riemann Sum Sandbox](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/calculus-sandbox): Scrub instantaneous rates of change with tangent lines dy/dx, and visually slice areas under curves into Riemann sum partitions. [NCERT Ch 6: Application of Derivatives - Ex 6.3 (Tangents and Normals)] (Category: Calculus)
- [The Rollercoaster Architect: Derivatives, Curvature & Integrals](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/rollercoaster-architect): Design a rollercoaster track with touch-drawn splines. Watch the 1st derivative f'(x) dictate instantaneous velocity, the 2nd derivative f''(x) compute G-force curvature κ(x), and definite integrals calculate the paint required for support pillars. [NCERT Ch 5: Continuity and Differentiability - Ex 5.1 (Differentiability & Smooth Curvature)] (Category: Calculus)
- [3D Vector Flight Lab: Dot & Cross Product](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/vector-flight-lab): Swing and orbit vectors in 3D coordinate space. Observe dot product projection shadows and watch the cross product normal vector expand with spanned parallelogram area. [NCERT Ch 10: Vector Algebra - Ex 10.3 & 10.4 (Dot Product & Cross Product)] (Category: Linear Algebra)
- [Fundamental Theorem of Calculus: Dynamic Area Accumulator](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/ftc-integral-accumulator): Watch the pinnacle theorem that connects differentiation and integration. Drag upper limit x to accumulate area A(x) = ∫ₐˣ f(t) dt slice by slice. Observe the instantaneous tangent slope of the area function A′(x) lock onto the curve height f(x), proving d/dx[∫ f] = f(x). [NCERT Ch 7: Integrals - Ex 7.8 & 7.9 (Fundamental Theorem of Calculus)] (Category: Calculus)
- [Bayes' Theorem: The Medical Test & Rare Event Detective](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/bayes-probability-lab): Defeat the Base Rate Fallacy! A medical screening test boasts 95% accuracy for a disease affecting 2% of the population. If a patient tests positive, what is the real probability they are actually sick? Drag prevalence and test accuracy sliders across 1,000 visual patients and frequency trees to witness why intuitive guesses are wrong by a factor of 10. [NCERT Ch 13: Probability - Ex 13.3 (Bayes’ Theorem & Total Probability)] (Category: Probability)
- [3D Geometry: Skew Lines, Shortest Distance & Planes](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/three-d-geometry-lab): Orbit around true 3D spatial lines! Drag line positions and direction vectors to understand why non-intersecting non-parallel lines (skew lines) exist in three dimensions, calculate their shortest distance using cross-product normals, and visualize the parallel planes sandwiching the lines. [NCERT Ch 11: Three Dimensional Geometry - Ex 11.2 & 11.3 (Shortest Distance between Skew Lines)] (Category: Conics & 3D)
- [Differential Equations & Slope Fields: Dynamic Trajectory Lab](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/differential-equations-lab): Flow along the vector currents of differential equations! Explore slope fields dy/dx = f(x, y), drag initial condition points (x₀, y₀) to trace unique solution curves (Euler method & analytical), and simulate Newton’s Law of Cooling and exponential decay. [NCERT Ch 9: Differential Equations - Ex 9.2 – 9.4 (Slope Fields & Solutions)] (Category: Calculus)
- [Linear Programming (LPP): Feasible Polygon & Iso-Profit](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/linear-programming-lab): Sweep iso-profit lines across convex feasible polygons to understand the Fundamental Theorem of LPP: optimal solutions always live at extreme corner vertices. [NCERT Ch 12: Linear Programming - Ex 12.1 (Corner Point Method)] (Category: Algebra)
- [Probability Distributions: Random Variables & Expected Value](https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/simulators/probability-distribution-lab): Explore discrete random variables and expected value center-of-mass balance pivots. Run live Monte Carlo simulations to watch the Law of Large Numbers in action. [NCERT Ch 13: Probability - Ex 13.4 (Probability Distribution & Mean)] (Category: Probability)

## Educational Pedagogy & Key Features
- Touch-first responsive physics canvas for student mobile phones and classroom smartboards.
- Step-by-step NCERT exercise references, common textbook traps, and past-year exam questions (PYQ).
- Predict-Observe-Explain (POE) micro-challenges built into each simulation.
- 100% free with no paywall or mandatory login requirements.
- Complete mathematical proofs and solutions available at https://labs.itsmathtime.co.in/llms-full.txt
